claim.reason: One drawn door symbol at the 2f corridor north wall / c006 south wall junction (2f_view.png): cyan door leaf at x~704-707px hinged at the west jamb with a single quarter-circle arc swinging north into c006; opening gap in the wall ink runs from the c002/c006 party wall line (x~699.5px, profile_002 C01, continuous y352-504, so no c002-c006 door) to the resumed wall ink at x=741px (profile_002 C02). Jamb pixels converted with map_pixels anchors taken from adjacent observed wall planes of the same drawing: x 699.5px=9.9405 m (party wall plane, profile_003) and x 745px=11.0598 m (c011 west wall line, profile_006); y 525px=16.0646 m (corridor north wall host plane, profile_007) and y 614px=13.9982 m (c011 south wall line, profile_005). Result: jamb x 9.9528 m and 10.9614 m on host plane y=16.0646; both jambs lie inside the c000/c006 shared segment (9.9405-11.0598 m).
unresolved: Jamb pixel readings carry about +-2 px (~0.05 m) uncertainty; the west jamb coincides with the drawn party wall line, i.e. the door begins at the c002/c006 party wall as drawn.
No 1f door position is implied; 1f layout of this junction was not examined.
